text:
ava: quick heads-up - I found an iframe message handler in /embed/player that doesn't validate event.origin. seems able to trigger admin-only UI actions if parent sends {type: 'runCmd'} :eyes:
matt: omg, can you repro? what actions exactly?
ava: repro in local - parent frame can send this and the handler does `if (msg.type === 'exec') execute(msg.payload)` without origin check. snippet: ```window.addEventListener('message', e => { if (e.data && e.data.type === 'exec') handleExec(e.data.payload) })```
sylvia: that's bad. is this only on customer-embedded widgets or internal admin embeds too?
ava: only the tenant embed path right now, but there's an admin toggle that exposes extra controls when staff cookie present. embedding + missing origin = escalation vector.
julian: risk: remote attacker could host a malicious page and trick a user (with session) to open embed, then parent triggers privileged actions. scope = user-scoped but some routes call service APIs that have elevated checks based on cookie headers.
ava: quick mitigation: block the endpoint from being embedded cross-origin with CSP + set X-Frame-Options on widget endpoints, and add origin check in message handler. I'm pushing a patch to the webapp repo now.
ops-oncall: can we do a protective WAF rule to drop suspicious post requests until deploy?
matt: WAF can't see postMessage, it's client-side. but we can enable a feature-flag to disable the embed widget for a short window. ops-oncall: doing that now (FF:embed-widget -> off) :white_check_mark:
sylvia: filing a CVE internal ticket? severity?
julian: recommend P2 (high) for production exposure. notify CISO + product for impacted customers. create customer comms draft after we confirm scope.
alert-bot: New finding recorded: SEC-2026-112 - iframe postMessage origin validation missing on /embed/player (reported by ava)
ava: patch PR: https://git.internal/webapp/pull/5823 - adds origin whitelist and message signature check, also toggles embed to same-site cookie requirement
matt: after deploy, we should run a quick audit across all message handlers: search for "addEventListener('message'" and verify origin checks. assign to @sylvia + @ava.
sylvia: on it — will run grep + quick static check and create follow-up tickets for any endpoints failing checks.
ops-oncall: feature flag disabled globally at 2026-11-03T15:12Z. rolling deploy of PR scheduled in the next 30m.
ava: will prepare detection rule: telemetry to flag postMessage-origin-mismatch events in the webapp logs, and create an alert if we see exec-type messages coming without referer header.
matt: nice. add an endpoint-level audit log entry for any action triggered via postMessage so we can trace if anything hit prod.
sylvia: final ask: notify support to escalate any customer reports about widgets disappearing. I'll draft an internal comms note for sales and support.
julian: thanks team. postmortem + root cause analysis after deploy.
ava: closing once deploy + audit done. :thumbsup:
